title: dryopteris biserialis
intro: Dryopteris biserialis, commonly known as the two-rowed wood fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Dryopteris biserialis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
